name: Haus Margreth
beschreibung: Haus Margreth in St. Leonhard im Pitztal is located in a quiet and close-to-nature setting. The guest rooms are comfortably furnished and have a private bathroom, and some have a balcony. The inn restaurant serves Tiroler cuisine with regional products. Hiking and cycling trails start directly at the house, and the Pitztal ski area is easily reachable. The Pitztaler Gletscher makes year-round skiing possible. The family hospitality shapes the special atmosphere of the inn.
